units.source_text: 女人在房间的角落，面朝里，把衣服的前襟整了整。

en.t: The woman stood in the corner of the room, facing inward, and straightened the front of her clothes.

units.source_text: 大概正松松腰带，把囤积的沙子抖落出来吧。

en.t: She was probably loosening her sash and shaking out the sand that had collected there.

units.source_text: 男人抓住铁锹柄的中间，把它举到与肩平行。

en.t: The man gripped the middle of the shovel handle and raised it level with his shoulder.

units.source_text: 铁锹的快口对准了靠泥地间门口的板壁……

en.t: The sharp edge of the shovel was aimed at the plank wall beside the entrance to the earthen-floored room...
